name: Dryer purge valve not seating
summary: The purge valve does not close between changeovers, so part of the delivered air escapes at the purge silencer instead of reaching the plant.
signal_moves_text: Dryer purge pressure is high while loaded.
checks: Listen at the purge silencer while the unit is loaded.
remedy: Overhaul or replace the purge valve and its pilot line.
